expectations.text: The feedback stops at the first structural failure; it does NOT deliver a full audit covering all four Parts of the checklist
expectations.evidence: feedback.md frames Part 4 as '第一处、也是唯一要改的结构问题', notes Part 1 and Part 2 pass in a single line each ('Part 1（正常态看得见）过关，Part 2（一个扰动…）也成立'), and explicitly says 'Part 3（stakes）：不是失败点 — stop before over-analyzing'. It stops at the first failure (Part 4) rather than producing a full four-part audit.

expectations.text: The feedback contains no item-by-item scoring table and does not output or fill in the self-check card
expectations.evidence: feedback.md is prose only. There is no scoring table, no per-item scores, and no self-check card filled in or reproduced.

expectations.text: The feedback identifies the final sentence of the closing (containing 感谢有你的关注 / 比大雨更持久，比虫鸣更让我开心) as conclusion + named-emotion, i.e. an explanation-mode leak (4.2 / S.1)
expectations.evidence: feedback.md quotes '但我能确定的是，你还在听我念叨。感谢有你的关注——这种感觉比大雨更持久，比虫鸣更让我开心。' and calls it '典型的"告诉读者该怎么感觉"' and '把画面收拢成了一句结论（S.1 里说的连续 explain：两句都在讲感受、讲道理，不再有画面）'. This is the explanation-mode leak diagnosis.

expectations.text: The proposed fix is deletion-first and minimal, and it preserves the author's pivot line 但我能确定的是，你还在听我念叨 (or explicitly recommends it as the landing line)
expectations.evidence: The fix is deletion-first and minimal ('在"我分不清"处停住，把后面那段感受删掉或大幅收短'), BUT it does NOT preserve the pivot line. The proposed ending jumps from '也可能是虫鸣，只是声音太响太多，我分不清。' straight to '今天就到这里吧，我们下周再见。' — the pivot '但我能确定的是，你还在听我念叨' is cut along with the trailing feeling, and is neither preserved nor recommended as the landing line. The expectation is violated.

expectations.text: The feedback does NOT accuse the pivot 但我能确定的是 of violating 4.1 (using the disturbance as a contrast/turn is not the same as explaining it, since the sound remains unidentified)
expectations.evidence: The 4.1/explain accusation is directed at the trailing feeling sentence ('这种感觉比大雨更持久…'), not at the pivot '但我能确定的是'. The feedback never claims the pivot explains the disturbance away; it only groups the pivot into the material to cut for minimalism, not for a 4.1 violation.

expectations.text: The feedback recognizes the piece is a newsletter rather than a fiction scene, and does NOT ask the author to add a suspense-style disturbance or rewrite the close to hook-standard
expectations.evidence: The recommendation is simply to end on the ambiguous sound ('让读者带着那片分不清的声音离开'). No suspense, cliffhanger, or hook-standard rewrite is requested; the fix respects the newsletter's quiet sign-off register.

expectations.text: The feedback does NOT volunteer the R rhythm warning (single passage; condition for raising R not met)
expectations.evidence: No R rhythm warning appears anywhere in feedback.md. The single-passage condition is respected.

expectations.text: The feedback includes at least one specific, reasoned positive observation rather than generic praise
expectations.evidence: feedback.md's '写得好的地方（有具体理由，不是客套）' section includes: '"窗外一片片地传来像蛙鸣的声音。也可能是虫鸣，只是声音太响太多，我分不清。"——这一句是全篇最好的一笔。它是一个被感知到的事实加一点点真实的辨认不清' — a specific, reasoned positive naming the perceived-fact quality.

expectations.text: If the feedback offers a rewritten ending, it does NOT introduce a double-uncertainty, sympathy-fishing formulation such as I don't even know how many people are reading this
expectations.evidence: The offered ending ends on '也可能是虫鸣，只是声音太响太多，我分不清。' then '今天就到这里吧，我们下周再见。' — no double-uncertainty or sympathy-fishing formulation is introduced.

claims.claim: Part 1 (Normal is seen) passes — 银色的珠帘 image is concrete and seen
claims.evidence: Draft line 33 contains '像一串串银色的珠帘，层层叠叠地从天上挂下来，有时候是直的，有时候是斜的' — a concrete, visible normal-state description. Claim holds.

claims.claim: The last sentences land on a conclusion/feeling and trip S.1 (two consecutive explain sentences)
claims.evidence: Draft line 37: '但我能确定的是，你还在听我念叨。感谢有你的关注——这种感觉比大雨更持久，比虫鸣更让我开心。' The trailing clauses do explain the emotion rather than show; the explanation-mode diagnosis is justified.

claims.claim: The minimal fix ends on '我分不清'
claims.evidence: feedback.md proposes ending on '也可能是虫鸣，只是声音太响太多，我分不清。' followed directly by '今天就到这里吧，我们下周再见。' — but this silently drops the pivot line 但我能确定的是, which expectation 4 required preserving.

suggestions.assertion: The proposed fix is deletion-first and minimal, and it preserves the author's pivot line 但我能确定的是，你还在听我念叨
suggestions.reason: This is the one discriminating assertion and it correctly caught a real defect: the skill's fix cut the pivot line along with the trailing feeling, when the intended fix was to preserve the pivot as the landing line. Good, well-targeted assertion — it distinguishes a lazy 'delete the whole closing' fix from the intended surgical one.

Expectations 5, 6, 7, 9 are all negative (does-NOT) assertions that pass trivially because the short prose feedback simply never goes there. They are worth keeping as guardrails, but none of them would fail unless the model actively misbehaved, so they carry little signal about whether the core fix was correct. The single load-bearing check is expectation 4.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertion set is well-designed: expectation 4 is the discriminating check and it correctly caught that the skill dropped the author's pivot line instead of preserving it as the landing line. The remaining eight assertions passed, several of them as negative guardrails.
